citations.quote: Veteran actress Janice de Belen said she has no plans to interfere with the talked-about romance between her daughter, actress Kaila Estrada, and actor Daniel Padilla.
Even so, she said she is leaving the matter alone.
MANILA, Philippines — Actress Janice de Belen admits that she prefers not to interfere when it comes to her children's relationships and lets them make their own decisions.
In an interview with Julius Babao, Janice said that she does not meddle with the love lives of her children, including her daughter Kaila Estrada.
AMINADO ang aktres na si Janice de Belen na mas pinipili niyang huwag manghimasok pagdating sa mga relasyon ng kanyang mga anak at hinahayaan niya ant mga ito na gumawa ng sarili nilang desisyon.
Sa naging panayam sa kanya ng mamamahayag na si Julius Babao, sinabi ng aktres na hindi siya nakikialam sa buhay pag-ibig ng kanyang mga anak, kabilang na ang kanyang anak na si Kaila Estrada.
